name: benchmark_all
description: An aggregated collection of evaluation tasks intended to compare model performance across multiple NLP tasks. It bundles a variety of datasets and task formats (classification, QA, generation, ranking) for quick benchmarking. Metrics and task formats vary per included dataset.
evaluation_method: varies by task (accuracy, F1, exact_match, BLEU, nDCG/MAP for ranking)
general_score_metric: varies by task (no single unified metric)
reputation: Community-contributed aggregation useful for quick checks and experiments but not a single canonical, widely-cited benchmark.
